mods.name: Base Hunting Client
mods.description: Anarchy base-hunting toolkit. Firework-free elytra autopilot with automatic elytra management, adaptive exploration, stash and new-chunk detection, player tracking, mending and ender chest handling, a safe storage system (inventory sorting, chest sorting, a container network, shulker work and restocking), survival guardrails and fully configurable Discord webhook notifications.

releases.notes:
## Base Hunting Client 2.0.0 — the storage release

A complete storage and inventory subsystem on top of the 1.1.0 exploration and equipment release.
Every storage action is planned by pure logic, queued to a single clicker, and only reported as done
once the live container actually matches the planned result.

**Download:** `basehunting-2.0.0.jar` (below). Requires Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader, and Meteor
Client. Baritone is optional (only Base Hunter v1 needs it).

### New storage modules

| Module | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `inventory-manager` | Sorts your inventory into a stable category order — on activate, after closing a container, or on an interval. |
| `chest-sorter` | Sorts any container, deposits/withdraws only the categories you select, and registers opened containers. |
| `storage-network` | A per-server, per-dimension container directory with last-known contents, and travel to a container. |
| `shulker-manager` | Fills, empties, sorts and searches shulker boxes. |
| `restock-manager` | Tops up travel supplies from registered storage, walking there with Baritone when available. |
| `storage-monitor` | Runs named workflows and is the storage status view. |

### Safety first

- **One thing clicks slots: `ContainerInteractionManager`.** Every feature plans moves as pure data and
  submits them there. An operation holds the `INVENTORY` lease for its whole life and only one runs at a
  time, so two features can never click at once.
- **Every operation is verified, not assumed.** The plan is simulated against the live container before
  the first click, and success is reported only once the container actually matches. A wrong settled
  state, a missing slot, or a timeout is a failure with a reason.
- **Deposits only move categories you selected.** A protection list and the reserve settings are a
  second gate; the selected slot, hotbar reserve and protected items never move, and stacks are never
  split.
- **A shulker whose contents were never seen is reported unknown, never empty.**
- **No packets are forged.** The player looks at a block, `interactBlock` runs, items move with normal
  slot clicks. A server refusal is reported, not worked around.

### Also in this release

- Storage & Inventory section in the management screen (`/bh gui`).
- Storage HUD lines (`show-storage`, `show-shulkers`).
- Commands: `/bh storage …`, `/bh shulker …`, `/bh workflow …`, `/bh restock …`.
- Storage notification categories with per-event cooldowns in the Discord notifier.
- A failed operation publishes `CONTAINER_OP_FAILED`, so it shows in chat, the GUI and Discord.

### Verification

`./gradlew clean build` — BUILD SUCCESSFUL. All suites run headlessly via `./gradlew verifyAddon`:

| Suite | Assertions |
| --- | --- |
| `plannerTest` | 21 |
| `coreLogicTest` | 175 |
| `storageLogicTest` | 131 (new) |
| `apiContractTest` | 36 |

The addon also loads in a real dev client: `Initializing Base Hunting Client` → `(Meteor Client) Loading`,
with no addon exceptions.

### Docs

- [README](https://github.com/logvex-sg/basehuntingclient-baritone/blob/main/README.md)
- [Full guide](https://github.com/logvex-sg/basehuntingclient-baritone/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/logvex-sg/basehuntingclient-baritone/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

### Known limitation

The storage system is verified by headless logic tests and a real client load. It has not been exercised
against a live multiplayer server with real containers. The architecture reports a server refusal as a
failure with a reason rather than a silent false success.
